content: Shell provisioners get a --dry-run that echoes instead of executing, then a bun test runs it with a failing stub binary first on PATH (dir:/usr/bin:/bin, needed for #!/usr/bin/env bash) so the assertions exercise the real script.

name: scenario-39-leak-guard-patterns
description: Scenario 39 leak-guard patterns: (1) redacted fields whose names collide with public ones (failureReason, cost) need structural key-walk assertions, not substring scans; (2) the event scrubber censors burrowId/burrowRunId on the KEY, so the field-name scan blanks the censored "[redacted]" pairs first; (3) proving the event-replay page bound means seeding DEFAULT_SNAPSHOT_PAGE_LIMIT+1 events and counting NDJSON lines (minus internal-only kinds); (4) held stream slots release asynchronously — poll the /metrics warren_event_streams gauge between cap-test phases.
